title: The Nethermancer's Requiem

{{Quest Infobox |image = The Nethermancer's Requiem.png |type = Main |nation = Huanglong |chapter = Chapter IV |actNum = Segue |act = |part = |characters = Abby;Jingran;Liangyu;Muyu;Qiuyuan;Rover;Suoming;Yinlin;Yanshu |description = With the crisis behind you, Liangyu seems to have something to discuss. Go find out what it is when you have a moment. You may soon be seeing that Nethermancer who worked alongside you at the Manifold Sanctum. |requirement = |startLocation = |prev = Song of the Heart Sword |next = Simulacrum of the Heart |rewards = Astrite*50;Union EXP*500;Advanced Resonance Potion*3;Advanced Sealed Tube*3;Shell Credit*30,000 }} {{Intro/Quest}} ==Gameplay== Completing this Quest rewards the following Trophy, [[Settling Old Debt]] ==Steps== # Talk to Liangyu # Head to Yanshu’s home and ask after Jingran # Go meet Jingran # Read Qingxiao’s WavesLine message ==Dialogue== {{Quest Description|With the crisis behind you, Liangyu seems to have something to discuss. Go find out what it is when you have a moment. You may soon be seeing that Nethermancer who worked alongside you at the Manifold Sanctum.}} {{Dialogue Start}} ;{{Icon/Quest|Main Quests}} Talk to Liangyu :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 1 1.ogg}} '''Liangyu:''' It's been some time, {{Rover}}. I trust you've been well? :{{DIcon}} How's your recovery going? :{{DIcon}} Yangyang mentioned you've already returned to duty. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 1 4.ogg}} '''Liangyu:''' I have recovered. Yangyang was with me in the last battle, and we made a good team. A few close calls, but we came through unharmed. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 1 5.ogg}} '''Liangyu:''' But on to pressing matters. Granny Yanshu asked me to pass you a message. She said, "Jing is back. Do you want to see him?" :{{DIcon}} I see. I think I'll pay them a visit. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 1 7.ogg}} '''Liangyu:''' The Paragon's report to the Ministry of War mentioned a Nethermancer who has been a great help... That must've been him, right? :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 1 8 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 1 8 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Do you know him? :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 1 9.ogg}} '''Liangyu:''' Xianling is a small village. The young ones grow up together. You cannot help but know each other. ---- :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 2 1 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 2 1 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' (I still have Jingran's Qingfu pendant. It's time to return it.) ---- ;{{Icon/Quest|Main Quests}} Head to Yanshu's home and ask after Jingran :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 10 1.ogg}} '''Yanshu:''' Ah, you came. Jing just stopped by to see me. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 10 2.ogg}} '''Yanshu:''' Hard to say what that boy's been doing all these years. But the Ministry of War sent him an official commendation. :{{DIcon}} How did he look? :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 10 4.ogg}} '''Yanshu:''' Oh... Not the best. But he flashed that sly grin of his when he saw me. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 10 5.ogg}} '''Yanshu:''' Back when Sandao and I took him in, he was like a stray cat. Just fire in his belly and wild to the bone. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 10 6.ogg}} '''Yanshu:''' Didn't happen overnight, but he simmered down eventually. No more talk about Mengzhou. No more talk about throwing his life away for his parents. :{{DIcon}} ...His parents? :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 10 8.ogg}} '''Yanshu:''' Ah, I've said too much. Happens with age. You'd best ask him yourself. He's out in the field by the woods nearby. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 10 9 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 10 9 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Perfect. I have something to return to him anyway. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 10 10.ogg}} '''Yanshu:''' Here, take [[Moonlit Splendor|this]] to him, please. Before he vanishes again. He's always had a sweet tooth for these. :File:Item Moonlit Splendor.png|100px|A confection Yanshu asked you to give to Jingran. Seems to be fresh out of the oven. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 20 1.ogg}} '''Abby:''' Hey, what's that ya got? Smells kinda scrumptious. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 20 2 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 20 2 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' This is for someone else. Don't you be getting any ideas. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 20 3.ogg}} '''Abby:''' (Aww—what crummy luck!) ---- :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 30 1 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 30 1 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' (The pendant is vibrating. He must be close by...) ---- ;{{Icon/Quest|Main Quests}} Go meet Jingran :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 40 1.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' ... :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 40 2.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' Hmph. Well, look who's here. Was gonna find you once I wrap things up. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 40 3 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 40 3 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Jingran, your eye... :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 40 4.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' Huh? Oh, been stayin' up late. Readin' too much. Nothing Huaxu's miracle eyedrops won't fix, though. :{{DIcon}} Come on, be serious. :{{DIcon}} You're not fooling anyone. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 40 7.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' It's nothing, just told "Mimi" to collect a little extra this time. Not the first time, won't be last. It'll pass. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 40 8.ogg}} '''{{tt|Mimi?|Lynx Spirit}}:''' The boy runs his mouth. If I hadn't jumped in, you'd be down there playing cards with your Shifu already. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 40 9.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' Heh, the old lady must've roped you into this. Thanks. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 40 10.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' You probably guessed already. This is that old score I told ya 'bout. The one I got with Muyu. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 40 11 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 40 11 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' This is where your... :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 40 12.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' Relax, they're empty. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 40 13.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' Couple decades back, Mengzhou had a real bad day. Some of the Atelier's Bladepuppets went haywire. Killed a bunch of folks. Two of 'em were Artisans. My parents. :
[[File:The Nethermancer's Requiem CG Jingran in the Past.gif|frame|none|link=File:The Nethermancer's Requiem CG Jingran in the Past.mp4]]
:{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 40 14.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' After that? No family. Nothin'. Ended up on the street. Then Shifu found me, dragged me back here to Xuanfang. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 40 15.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' Back then, all I wanted was to sneak into Mengzhou and cut the guts out of whoever did it. But he knocked me around, set me straight. Then he brought me here. Had me build these two graves. Empty ones. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 40 16.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' Said, "Kid, worry about moving forward first. You can settle scores when you're older." Ever since, whenever I start to lose my cool, I come here. Just... sit. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 40 17.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' A few years later, I went back to Mengzhou to dig into what happened. The patrol records proved it—those Bladepuppets had Reverberation marks on 'em. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 40 18.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' So I followed that thread... and it led me right to Muyu. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 40 19.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' Guess I can finally tell my folks it's settled. Shame I can't give Shifu a proper thank-you. Face-to-face, I mean. :{{DIcon}} ...Why not? :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 40 21.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' The old coot made me promise that when he kicks it, no grave, no marker, no nothing. Tch, live clean, die clean. He locked himself away in some Mirage Realm, lamp and all. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 40 22 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 40 22 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Jingran, I think it's time... to give you this back. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 40 23.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' Nah, keep it. Call it a souvenir. Thing ain't worth much, and the Resonance Energy stuck to it just burnt out anyway. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 40 24.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' I mean, I could charge it up for ya. Maybe... three months. Tops. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 40 25 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 40 25 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Knock off throwing your life away, would you? :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 40 26.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' Ain't many things in this world I give a crap about. But I gotta say, lately... I've finally met someone interesting. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 40 27 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 40 27 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Looks like the great Nethermancer, the "Cat of the Nether Lamp" himself didn't find any treasure this time. Just ended up losing a trinket. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 40 28.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' Don't count my losses yet. I never do a bad deal. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 40 29.ogg}} '''Mimi?:''' Hmph. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 40 30.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' ...Already down to my last. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 40 31 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 40 31 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Are those... Reverberations? :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 40 32.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' They used to be people. ---- :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 50 1.ogg}} '''???:''' ...Must survive... The truth is within reach... :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 50 2.ogg}} '''???:''' There is still a chance... My path does not end here... :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 50 3.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' Whoa there. And where d'you think you're slitherin' off to— :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 50 4.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' Former Helmsmaster of the {{Extra Effect|Jianshui Branch|Jianshui Branch|One of the sub-branches under the main branch of Zhuojun Atelier.
Besides the Jianshui Branch, the sub-branches also include the Juqu Branch and the Zhijiang Branch. Together, the three branches each oversee one of the three major river basins beyond the Luo River in Mengzhou.}}, Muyu? :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 50 5.ogg}} '''Muyu:''' Traitor... How did you find me? :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 50 6.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' Think I read about this in some old storybook. The old {{Rubi|"sacrifice the body, save the spirit"|Bingjie}} trick? :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 50 7.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' You let someone cut you loose from your old shell, then slipped away in the chaos. Clever. Real clever. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 50 8.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' But you went and bent your psyche into a Reverberation. You really think I couldn't track that? 'S kinda what I do. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 50 9.ogg}} '''Muyu:''' I admit defeat... That core contains data on the Sentinel. Its worth is incalculable... :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 50 25.ogg}} '''Muyu:''' It could be yours... For Nethermancers... No, for Xuanfang, it would mean everything... :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 50 10.ogg}} '''Muyu:''' All I need is time... Just give me a little more time... and the Sentinel's secret will be laid bare... :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 50 11.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' Two things you got wrong. First? You got nothing to bargain with. Second? Yeah, this thing's nice, but it ain't that nice... not to me. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 50 12.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' Hey, remember that Bladepuppet incident in Mengzhou... what, ten, fifteen years back? :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 50 13.ogg}} '''Muyu:''' Bladepuppet incident... what was that? I... do not recall... :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 50 14.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' Tch. Amazing the things you big shots forget. Or did your "escape by execution" stunt scramble your brains? :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 50 15.ogg}} '''Muyu:''' ...Just who are you? :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 50 16.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' Forget it, then. Don't matter. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 50 17.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' But you'll remember this. The one who ends you... was just an ordinary peasant from Xuanfang. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 50 18.ogg}} '''Muyu:''' ...Humanity... could have been... perfect... :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 50 19.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' You stopped being human a long time ago. Where's the perfect in that? :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 50 20.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' ...Why didn't you stop me? Coulda squeezed him for more info, if you'd wanted. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 50 21.ogg}} '''Qiuyuan:''' Matters of revenge, only the wronged can decide. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 50 22.ogg}} '''Qiuyuan:''' Besides... his corpse is not without use. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 50 23.ogg}} '''Jingran:''' Here. You lot'll put it to better use than me. ---- :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 60 1.ogg}} '''Suspicious Artisan:''' What's taking so long... Why isn't the contact here yet? Could the former Helmsmaster's arrangements have gone wrong...? :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 60 2.ogg}} '''Calm Artisan:''' Don't lose your head. If something has changed, we will simply report to headquarters ourselves. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 60 3.ogg}} '''???:''' Aw, didn't see me here? :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 60 4.ogg}} '''Calm Artisan:''' You're the contact for the Zhijiang Branch? :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 60 5.ogg}} '''Yinlin:''' Spare me the little tricks. You were waiting for the Jianshui Branch. What, do I not look the part? :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 60 6.ogg}} '''Suspicious Artisan:''' Uh... "Windingflow Vessel"? :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 60 7.ogg}} '''Yinlin:''' "Hundredfold Assemblage." :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 60 8.ogg}} '''Calm Artisan:''' Pardon our disrespect. You came at the right time. We have {{Rubi|the former Helmsmaster's|Muyu}} manuscripts from his time in Xuanfang, and a recent secret letter. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 60 9.ogg}} '''Yinlin:''' Top-notch work, fellas. The Grand Helm will definitely know your names after this. No time to waste, you'll be coming with me. Except... :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 60 10.ogg}} '''Yinlin:''' I'm afraid I'll have to restrain you. Just a little. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 60 11.ogg}} '''Calm Artisan:''' Why you—?! :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 60 12.ogg}} '''Yinlin:''' Shh. For your own sake, I recommend you save your breath. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 60 13.ogg}} '''Yinlin:''' Ah... Lady Suoming. What brings you to Xuanfang? :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 60 18.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' So, you are the Jinzhou Patroller seconded to Mengzhou? :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 60 14.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' Don't misunderstand. I'm not here for the Atelier's affairs. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 60 15.ogg}} '''Yinlin:''' The Ministry of Sentinel Affairs governs the Sentinel's business. You being here... Could it be— :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 60 16.ogg}} '''Suoming:''' You already know all you need to know. Take care. :{{A|Vo main mengzhou 3 6 2 60 17.ogg}} '''Yinlin:''' See you around, {{Rover}}... If we're lucky. ---- ;{{Icon/Quest|Quests Interact}} Read Qingxiao's WavesLine message {{WavesLine|text = :Friend sent a nudge :'''Qingxiao:''' ...I accidentally tapped your profile picture again. :'''Qingxiao:''' Disciple, I find that I neglected to give you a proper initiation gift. :{Choice} There's more than one? ::'''(Rover):''' What about the sword talisman? There's more than one initiation gift? :{Choice} Oh? I like the sound of that. ::'''(Rover):''' Oh? I like the sound of that. :'''Qingxiao:''' The sword talisman was a symbol of our bond as master and disciple. An inaugural gift for the first disciple in my school is its own matter. :'''Qingxiao:''' Here it is. I only finished crafting it recently. :{Choice} This is... ::'''(Rover):''' This is... :'''Qingxiao:''' This qin... is one of only two in this world. The other is mine. It has remained silent with me for a century. I believed the opportunity to find an owner for it had passed. :'''Qingxiao:''' But it would appear the day has finally come. Henceforth, it now belongs to you. :'''Qingxiao:''' If the way of music speaks to you, I hope you will play it often. :{Choice} Thank you. I will not decline such a gift. ::'''(Rover):''' Thank you. I will not decline such a gift. :'''Qingxiao:''' Even if you did, I would still insist that you take it. :{Choice} ...? ::'''(Rover):''' ...? :'''Qingxiao:''' Should you ever have questions about the qin, you may come to me. I will teach you.}} (''Quest complete: The Nethermancer's Requiem'') {{Dialogue End}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = The Nethermancer's Requiem |zhs = 幽客销残声 |zht = 幽客銷殘聲 |ja = 幽客の残り声 |ko = 떠도는 유람객, 사라지는 잔향 |fr = Requiem de l'Abyssomancien |de = Requiem des Unterweltwandlers |es = Réquiem del nigromante |th = ผู้ท่องปรภพสยบวิบัติสำเนียง |pt = Réquiem do Inframante }} ==Change History== {{Change History|3.6}} ==Navigation== {{Quest Navbox|Main Quests}}
